svg.font-family: "Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue","Liberation Sans",Arial,sans-serif,"Hiragino Sans","Noto Sans JP","Yu Gothic","Meiryo","IPAPGothic",sans-serif
svg.title: Precision–recall curves for the same failure-risk model in two fleets, with a ROC inset
svg.desc: North fleet: 6.0% failures, AP 0.57. South fleet: 1.5% failures, AP 0.38. At the 0.30 threshold precision is 44% in the north and 16% in the south. ROC AUC is 0.93 and 0.91: the ROC view hides the difference.
svg.text: Precision: share of alerts that are real failures

text.tspan: The same model on ROC axes
